question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Laconic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Concise**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Laconic **means using very few words to express what you mean. (अपने मतलब को व्यक्त करने के लिए बहुत कम शब्दों का उपयोग करना)

 
 
• Example -* His laconic reply suggested a lack of interest in the topic.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Concise **means giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief but comprehensive. (संक्षिप्त लेकिन व्यापक)
 
 
• Example -* She wrote up a concise summary of the day's events.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Laconic**' and '**Concise**' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Exaggerated **means regarded or represented as larger, better, or worse than in reality. (वास्तविकता की तुलना में बड़ा, बेहतर या बुरा माना जाता है या उसका प्रतिनिधित्व किया जाता है)
 
• **Lengthy **means having or being of great length; very long. (बड़ी लंबाई का होना या होना; बहुत लम्बा)
 
• **Talkative** means fond of or given to talking. (बातूनी)
